findings.title: Failed stats request is shown as 'No harvests in this range'
findings.expected: When the stats request fails (500), the page shows a visible error and a way to retry
findings.actual: No error appears. The page shows the empty state 'No harvests in this range', so it looks as if the range has no harvests
findings.evidence: {"alerts":[],"text":["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","No harvests in this range","Pick a different date range, or log a harvest to see it here.","Log harvest","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]} | {"alerts":[],"text":["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","No harvests in this range","Pick a different date range, or log a harvest to see it here.","Log harvest","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]}

findings.title: From date after To date (from the URL) shows the empty state instead of the validation reason
findings.expected: The server's 422 'The From date must be on or before the To date.' is shown to the user
findings.actual: The page shows 'No harvests in this range' with no explanation
findings.evidence: {"text":["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","No harvests in this range","Pick a different date range, or log a harvest to see it here.","Log harvest","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]} | {"text":["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","No harvests in this range","Pick a different date range, or log a harvest to see it here.","Log harvest","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]}

findings.title: Malformed stats response crashes the page and leaves it stuck on 'Loading stats…' with stale data
findings.expected: An unexpected response shape shows an error with no uncaught exception
findings.actual: Uncaught TypeError 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')'. 'Loading stats…' stays on screen while the table still shows the previous range's data
